name: Resend Email
description: Transactional emails with Resend — developer-friendly API, React Email templates, and built-in analytics.
postInstallNotes:
1. Verify your sending domain in the Resend dashboard to avoid emails landing in spam.
2. Set `EMAIL_FROM` to your verified sender address (e.g. `App Name <hello@yourdomain.com>`).
3. For rich templates, add the `react-email` package and pass React components as the `react` option.
